description: Verify that Two SOME/IP Method Requests in one UDP datagram — DUT replies to both
approach:
[Objective]
Bundling: a single L4 datagram may carry multiple SOME/IP messages — DUT must process and respond to each.

[Scenario — chronological]
1. DUT → Tester: OfferService.
2. Tester → DUT: Method Request (per-case shape).
3. Observation: DUT → Tester: Method Response (or absence) per the asserted behaviour.

[Pass condition]
DUT-emitted response satisfies the spec property.

[Fail condition]
Per-phase Fail_phase<n>_* per the verdict list.

verdicts.Pass: DUT responded to every message — normal
verdicts.Fail_phase2_response_missing: DUT did not respond to every message in bundle
